primary_endpoint.statement: KRT5+ area divided by DAMAGED ALVEOLAR area, where damaged alveolar area is parenchyma lacking AT1 coverage (AGER-negative territory measured at alveolar scale). Both terms are measured inside the same parenchymal ROI on the same section.
primary_endpoint.reference: Lin X. et al., J Clin Invest 2024;134(19):e176828, DOI 10.1172/JCI176828 (PMID 39352385): 'percentages of KRT5+ dysplastic cell areas in damaged alveolar areas'.
primary_endpoint.reference_method: Manual outline spline in Axiovision 4.8. There is therefore NO published automated threshold to inherit, and hand-drawn outlines on a subset are the only available ground truth for validating this automation.

numerator.description: Independent thresholded KRT5 area with the 50 um2 connected-component filter, summed over endpoint rows. Emitted at IF_Quant_Pipeline.groovy:2743.

denominator.description: Calibrated area of the ROI the engine measured (IF_Quant_Pipeline.groovy:2604). Its SCOPE is the damaged partition; see region_scope.
denominator.why_not_total_tissue: KRT5+ area / total tissue area silently measures infection severity: pod area scales with how much lung was damaged, which varies animal to animal, so a smaller pod area in a KO could just mean a milder infection. Normalising to damaged area is what makes the genotype comparison honest (docs/ECTOPIC_POD_ENDPOINT.md:23-28).

aggregation.path: tile rows (2 per tile: parenchyma_damaged + parenchyma_intact) -> aggregate_tiles_to_slide.py keeps ONLY the 'damaged' rows as endpoint rows and sums them into one slide row whose region_area_um2 IS the damaged area (aggregate_tiles_to_slide.py:225-228, 272-284) -> aggregate_to_mouse.py pools slide rows per (mouse_id, genotype, condition, panel) and recomputes KRT5_pod_area_frac = sum(KRT5_pod_area_um2) / sum(region_area_um2) (aggregate_to_mouse.py:325-332) -> group_stats with n = mice.

interpretation_limits: Conducting airways are NOT excluded from numerator or denominator. Airway basal cells are KRT5+ in every animal, so the numerator currently contains a genotype-independent airway component. The 'ectopic' claim is not yet earned.
n = 1 mouse per group cell in the current pilot. This supports pipeline validation and threshold freezing only; it does not support a group comparison (docs/ECTOPIC_POD_ENDPOINT.md:297-302).
'het' is likely the control rather than a second genotype arm: a heterozygous Ifng+/- often retains enough cytokine to signal normally. Confirm the line before interpreting any pod difference.
No agreement measurement against hand-drawn outlines exists, and the reference method is manual, so the automated endpoint is not yet shown to measure the same quantity as the literature.

confounds.mechanism: A global IFN-gamma ligand knockout can alter viral clearance. If KO animals clear PR8 more slowly (or faster), they sustain a different amount of alveolar destruction, so a difference in KRT5+ pod area may be an infection-severity difference rather than a difference in the dysplastic response.
confounds.orthogonal_assay_required: Influenza NP immunostaining on a serial section, or NP qPCR. No image analysis can substitute for it.

confounds.mechanism: Conducting airways are not excluded. Airway basal cells are KRT5+ in every animal, so the numerator carries an airway component whose size depends on how much airway each tile happens to contain.
confounds.orthogonal_assay_required: Manual airway polygons in QuPath, drawn blinded with the KRT5 channel off, exported as GeoJSON in slide coordinates and subtracted per tile by Stage 1.

confounds.mechanism: Airway epithelium is AGER-negative and so is severely injured alveolar parenchyma. An 'exclude AGER-poor regions as airway' rule would preferentially delete the pods it is meant to measure.
confounds.orthogonal_assay_required: none - this is a design prohibition, not a measurement gap. AGER-negative as DENOMINATOR is correct; AGER-negative as AIRWAY DETECTOR is forbidden (docs/ECTOPIC_POD_ENDPOINT.md:59-74).
confounds.resolution_evidence: Prohibited in compartment_tags.forbidden_uses; no code path in Stage 1 uses AGER for airway detection.

confounds.mechanism: Otsu assumes a bimodal distribution. On a slide with almost no KRT5 signal there is no second mode, so it splits noise: uninfected m6 read 4.95% KRT5+ at an Otsu threshold of 54.6, indistinguishable from an infected animal. With per-slide adaptive AGER thresholds the damage comparison INVERTED at all 15 parameter combinations tested.
confounds.resolution_evidence: Stage 1 refuses to partition without an explicit IFQ_WSI_AGER_THRESHOLD (qupath_wsi_tile_export.groovy:229-239). The Stage 2 KRT5 threshold is still not frozen, so this confound remains OPEN for the numerator - see calibration requirement krt5_threshold_freeze.

confounds.mechanism: The KRT5/488 channel was acquired at ~949 ms versus ~0.5-2 ms for the other channels, so autofluorescence in that band is amplified relative to everything else and argues for a conservative threshold.
confounds.orthogonal_assay_required: Secondary-only or unstained section at identical exposure.

confounds.mechanism: n = 1 mouse per group cell. With n = mice as the statistical unit, no group comparison is possible; any apparent difference is a single-animal anecdote.

forbidden_uses: Do NOT use AGER or PDPN negativity to detect conducting airway. The most damaged alveolar regions are the most AGER-poor, and that is precisely where pods form; an AGER-based airway filter would delete the pods and bias toward the null.

Do NOT name a tile ROI 'alveolar_*' until airway polygons are actually subtracted. Naming asserts the claim: the engine tags compartments by substring on the ROI name (IF_Quant_Pipeline.groovy:2102-2109), so 'alveolar_core' on a pure-airway tile is a silent mislabel.

Do NOT interpret the ambiguous/unassigned degradation of AGER and T1A calls as a KRT5 problem. With the neutral ROI name those two markers declare expectedCompartment 'alveolar' and correctly degrade to context_unresolved/indeterminate; the pod-area endpoint is unaffected.

calibration_requirements.selection_rule: Declared before any number was read. Constraint: worst-of-both control damaged fraction <= alpha (worst-of-both, not the mean - one clean slide must not buy tolerance for a dirty one). Objective: subject to that, the LARGEST cutoff, because damaged% is monotone increasing in cutoff so the largest admissible cutoff is the most sensitive operating point that still meets the specificity floor. Ties break toward the flattest local slope.

Target: smallest threshold whose false-positive KRT5 AREA FRACTION inside INTACT control parenchyma is <= 1e-4, evaluated worst-of-both controls. If no threshold reaches the target, the target is not met and the run stays exploratory; do not relax the target silently to whatever the data allows.

Pre-register where the airway annotation boundary falls relative to a peribronchiolar pod; it materially changes the endpoint. Primary rule fixed before unblinding; a dilation sensitivity analysis at 0 / +10 / +25 um bounds it honestly but does not replace the primary rule.

Blinded manual outlines on a random subset; report Bland-Altman bias and limits of agreement for both the damaged-area denominator and the KRT5+ numerator, plus the endpoint ratio. Declare the acceptable limits BEFORE drawing.
